content: ADO global limit 200 TSTUs per sliding 5-min window; delays up to 30s then 429 TF400733. Headers Retry-After (may arrive on HTTP 200), X-RateLimit-Resource/Delay/Limit/Remaining/Reset/Cost; all but Delay sent before throttling begins. azure-devops-go-api typed clients (b5 and v7.1.0) build http.Client internally; v7 exposes NewClientWithOptions(WithHTTPClient) but typed NewClient does not use it.
